Function ClickButton(Identifier,Data,RC,Data_TC) Dim uThere,uEnabled,uText Dim m_happy_env, m_happy Dim mDeskPhoto On Error Resume Next ClickButton = False Set m_happy_env = environment.Value("INST_CURRENT_OBJ") m_happy = m_happy_env.m_strObject If Data = "" Then Data = Data_TC End If Reporter.Filter = rfEnableErrorsAndWarnings Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO","Before exist") Execute "uThere =" & Identifier & ".exist(0)" If Not Catch(Err.number,Err.description)Then : Exit Function If uThere <> True Then Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, m_happy & " Not found", "Button not found on screen" Call DeskTopPhotoGraph(mDeskPhoto) Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Fail","ClickButton",m_happy,Data,"Object does not exist",mDeskPhoto) ClickButton = False Exit Function End If
Execute "uEnabled=" & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""enabled"")" If Not Catch(Err.number,Err.description)Then : Exit Function If uEnabled <> True Then Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, m_happy & " Not enabled", "object not ready to receive input" Call DeskTopPhotoGraph(mDeskPhoto) Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Fail","ClickButton",m_happy,Data,"Object disabled",mDeskPhoto) ClickButton = False Exit Function End If
Reporter.Filter = rfEnableAll Dim isSplitter, strTypeName, objInst Execute "set objInst=" & Identifier strTypeName = objInst.getROProperty("swftypename") If InStr(strTypeName,"Splitter")>0 Then isSplitter = True Else isSplitter = False End If If Not isSplitter Then Execute Identifier & ".Click()" Else Dim iWidth, iX iWidth = objInst.getROProperty("width") iX = Int(iWidth / 2) objInst.click iX, 1 End If
If Not Catch(Err.number,Err.description)Then : Exit Function Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO","ClickButton End")
Reporter.ReportEvent micDone,"ClickButton Keyword completed for " & m_happy ,"Data: " & Data Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Done", "ClickButton",m_happy,"","","")
ClickButton = True End Function

'======================================================= ' Description: ' QTP sometimes could not click a button when a script is running. ' To make clickbutton runs, performClick api of button is called. This ' KeyWord can only be used in one case when clickButton doesn't ' Work. ' Creator: ' Marquis ' Date: 07-10-2014 ' Version: 1.0 '======================================================= Function ClickButtonEx(Identifier,Data,RC,Data_TC)
Dim uThere,uEnabled,uText Dim m_happy_env, m_happy Dim mDeskPhoto
On Error Resume Next ClickButtonEx = False
'Get the Happy Name Set m_happy_env = environment.Value("INST_CURRENT_OBJ") m_happy = m_happy_env.m_strObject
'If the value in the Test Case column is blank then use the data from the Data Workbook. If Data = "" Then Data = Data_TC End If

' Setting.Webpackage("ReplayType")= 2 ' Check to see if the object exists. Execute "uEnabled=" & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""enabled"")" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function If uEnabled <> True Then Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, m_happy & " Not enabled", "object not ready to receive input" ClickButtonEx = False Exit Function End If
Reporter.Filter = rfEnableAll ' Send All messages to the QTP Result log.
Dim objDes Execute "set objDes = " & Identifier objDes.object.PerformClick() 'Click on the button. 'Execute Identifier & ".Click()" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO","ClickButton End")
Reporter.ReportEvent micDone,"ClickButton Keyword completed for " & m_happy ,"Data: " & Data
ClickButtonEx = True End Function

Function CaptureValue(byval Identifier,byval Data,byval RC,ByRef Data_TC) 'Get the value of an item from Summit with consideration of the object type. ' Send the value back to the Data_TC parameter. The harness returns ' this value to the data workbook container. It has been tested for SwfEdit and 'SwfDropdown. The other types including SwfTable can be added as needed. Dim uThere,uText,uClassName Dim m_happy_env, m_happy Dim mDeskPhoto
On Error Resume Next CaptureValue = False
'Get the Happy Name Set m_happy_env = environment.Value("INST_CURRENT_OBJ") m_happy = m_happy_env.m_strObject
Reporter.Filter = rfEnableErrorsAndWarnings ' Send only Errors and Warnings to the QTP log.
'added by tiger for xml captureValue If typename(Identifier)="XMLObjectInfo" Then 'xml capture mode Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO", "to call Xml capture...") Dim iXmlResult iXmlResult = XmlCaputreValue(Identifier, Data_TC) If iXmlResult<>0 Then Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Fail","CaptureValue",m_happy,"","Call xml Capture fail with return code:" & iXmlResult,"") CaptureValue = iXmlResult else CaptureValue = 0 End If Exit function End If
' Setting.Webpackage("ReplayType")= 2 ' Check to see if the object exists. Execute "uThere =" & Identifier & ".exist(0)" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function If uThere <> True Then Reporter.ReportEvent micFail, identifier & "Not found", "Button not found on screen" Call DeskTopPhotoGraph(mDeskPhoto) 'p1 = Fail | p2 = KeyWord | p3 = HappyName | p4 = Data | p5 = Messages | p6 = image Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Fail","CaptureValue",m_happy,"","Object does not exist",mDeskPhoto) CaptureValue = False Exit Function End If
If gisHighLightComponet Then execute Identifier &".highlight" End If
'Get the class name of the object to find out its type. Execute "uClassName =" & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""Class Name"")"
uClassName = uCase(uClassName)
'Get the value and send it back out through the Data parameter of the function. Select Case uClassName Case "SWFWINDOW" Execute "Data_TC = " & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""text"")" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function Case "SWFEDIT" On error resume next execute Identifier & ".click 1,1" On error goto 0 Execute "Data_TC = " & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""text"")" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function Case "SWFCOMBOBOX" Execute "Data_TC = " & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""text"")" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function Case "SWFLABEL" Execute "Data_TC = " & Identifier & ".GetROProperty(""text"")" If Not Catch(err.number,err.description)Then : Exit Function Case "SWFTABLE" On error resume next Dim strCaseValue strCaseValue = ucase(strValue) Dim objTable,column_row column_row=RC ' To match the name of the parameter. Execute "set objTable="& Identifier
Dim iRowCnt,iCheckCount iCheckCount = 0 For i=0 to 4 iRowCnt = objTable.object.Rows.count If iRowCnt>0 Then Exit for else Call wait(10) End If Next
'get Column from column_row 'SearchAndClick DEALERS_TABLE _dealer DONE Dim arrCR,iRowLoop,strValue strValue = Data ' to make the parameter name match. arrCR = split(column_row,";") If ubound(arrCR)<>1 Then Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("ERROR","To use SearchAndClick Keyword, 'row_column' filed should be two fields....") CaptureValue = ID_ERROR_SEARCHCLICK_CRFORMAT Exit function End If
mRow = ArrCR(0) If IsNumeric(mRow) = False Then mRow = Ucase(mRow) End If
If arrCR(0)="" Then iRowLoop = iRowCnt -1 arrCR(0) = CNST_TABLE_DYNAMICROW ElseIf strcomp(mRow,"ALLROWS" ) = 0 Then 'Do nothing here for this condition Else iRowLoop = arrCR(0) - 1 End If
'find Column Id Dim iColumnId iColumnId = -1 If iRowCnt<=0 Then Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO","No row exists. Case "(" 'Parenthesis ThisChar = "{(}" Case ")" ThisChar = "{)}" Case "[" 'Brackets ThisChar = "{[}" Case "]" ThisChar = "{]}" Case "{" 'Braces ThisChar = "{{}" Case "}" ThisChar = "{}}" Case "+" 'Plus sign ThisChar = "{+}" Case "^" 'caret ThisChar = "{^}" Case "%" 'percent sign ThisChar = "{%}" Case "~" 'tilde ThisChar = "{~}" End Select wsh.SendKeys ThisChar Call Wait (0,20) Next Reporter.Filter = rfEnableAll ' Send All messages to the QTP Result log. End Function

Function WaitForSeconds(strIdentifier,Data,RC,Data_TC) Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO", "WaitForSeconds:"&Data_TC)
Reporter.Filter = rfEnableErrorsAndWarnings If (Data_TC="") Then Data_TC = 3 End If If Not IsNumeric(Data_TC) Then Reporter.ReportEvent micDone, " WaitForSeconds uses non-numeric parameter, default value 3 will be applied.", "Default value 3 will be applied." End If
If RC="" Or StrComp(UCase(RC),"SMARTWAIT")<>0 Then Call wait(Data_TC) Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Done", "waitForSeconds","",Data_TC,"","") On Error Goto 0 waitForSeconds = 0 Exit Function End If
Dim objTopApplicationWindow, iTimeWait, iDefaultCnt, strCursor,bStayWait, strError iTimeWait = 0 iDefaultCnt = 0 bStayWait = True On Error Resume Next Set objTopApplicationWindow = swfwindow("is owned window:=False","is child window:=False","text:=Misys Summit FT.*", "index:=0") Do While bStayWait strCursor = objTopApplicationWindow.Object.cursor.toString If InStr(1,UCase(strCursor),UCase("wait"))>0 Then iTimeWait = iTimeWait +10 iDefaultCnt = 0 Call wait(10) Else If InStr(1, UCase(strCursor), UCase("default"))>0 Then iDefaultCnt = iDefaultCnt + 1 Else iDefaultCnt = 0 End If Call wait(1) iTimeWait = iTimeWait + 1 End If If iDefaultCnt>=2 Then bStayWait = False strError = "find cursor turned to default [" & iDefaultCnt &"] times, Framework takes application as available now...Total wait seconds is " & iTimeWait Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO",strError) Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Done", "waitForSeconds","",Data_TC,strError,"") On Error Goto 0 Exit Do Else If iTimeWait>(Data_TC) Then bStayWait = False strError = "find cursor turned to default [" & iDefaultCnt &"] times, But wait time is over.Total wait seconds is " & iTimeWait Call u_WriteOneLine2LogFile("INFO",strError) Call u_ReportInfo2Word("Done", "waitForSeconds","",Data_TC,strError,"") On Error Goto 0 Exit Do End If End If
Loop On Error Goto 0
Reporter.ReportEvent micDone,"WaitForSeconds Keyword completed","Data_TC: " & Data_TC WaitForSeconds = True End Function
